fields.description: Issue features political commentary and local civic disputes, including extensive discussion of the Huttoe case involving Miami police officials (Capt. J. E. Barker and Chief Walter Headley) and criticism of Miami daily newspapers’ handling of related facts. Coverage includes City Commissioner H. Leslie Quigg’s denial of Ku Klux Klan membership and allegations of press misquotation; debate over legalized gambling and bookmaking (with attention to Miami Beach’s tourist economy); and a report on Miami Transit bus-stop changes and their impact on small businesses and traffic. Additional items include local court news (drunkenness, disturbances, firearms incident), a University of Miami professors’ debate on climate factors, and reports on Florida oil exploration and development, with mention of Crandon Park and Miami Beach as recreational/tourism concerns.
